scope: Only the highlighted April16-April27 source episode; not all earlier/later price history.

proposals.label: 方案一：一個整理區間，內部重心下移
proposals.interpretation: Treat the two observed local centres as phases inside one local consolidation; not merely the already permitted broader observation thread.

proposals.label: 方案二：上方整理轉弱，較低活動另列
proposals.interpretation: Preserve two overlapping local structure candidates within one observable sequence; do not force a disjoint formal cut at April23.
